parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: On Fig. 8.1, draw an arrow to show the direction of the magnetic field at wire Q due to the current in wire P. Label this arrow $B$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: On Fig. 8.1, draw another arrow to show the direction of the force acting on wire Q due to the current in wire P. Label this arrow $F$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State, with a reason, how the magnitude of the force acting on wire P compares with the magnitude of the force acting on wire Q.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State how the direction of the force on wire P compares with the direction of the force on wire Q.
